title: Final temperature expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must correctly state the final temperature as T₂ = (V₂/V₁) T₁.

title: Final internal energy expression
description: Essential Criteria: The answer must correctly state the change in internal energy as ΔU = Q₁ - (p₀ + mg/S)(V₂ - V₁).

title: Pressure identification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must identify that the process is isobaric with pressure p = p₀ + mg/S.

title: First law application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the first law of thermodynamics, ΔU = Q + W.

title: Work calculation sign
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the work done by the gas as W = -pΔV.

title: Charles's Law reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly invoke Charles's Law or the ideal gas law for an isobaric process.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may demonstrate that the terms in the internal energy expression have consistent units of energy.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the work done on/by the gas has the incorrect sign (e.g., W = +pΔV).

title: Incorrect pressure value
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the gas pressure is stated incorrectly, such as omitting the piston's contribution (mg/S).
